description: This file defines the NoteViewHolder class, which manages the display and interaction logic for note items in a RecyclerView within an Android application. It handles setting content, tags, background color, attachments, and selection state for note views.

classes.name: NoteViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView ViewHolder that manages the display of a note item, including content, tags, attachments, and interaction handling.

methods.name: updateBackgroundColor
methods.description: Updates the background color of the note item based on the NoteColor.

methods.name: updateTags
methods.description: Updates the display of tags associated with the note, reusing views to optimize performance.

methods.name: updateIndicatorIcons
methods.description: Sets visibility of indicator icons based on note properties and search mode.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the note's title text and visibility.

methods.name: setTextContent
methods.description: Sets the main content of the note, applying markdown if enabled.

methods.name: setTasks
methods.description: Displays the list of tasks if the note is a list type.

methods.name: setupAttachments
methods.description: Prepares and displays attachments associated with the note.

methods.name: runPayloads
methods.description: Updates the view based on a set of payloads indicating what has changed.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Note object to the view, updating all display elements.

methods.name: onSelectedStatusChanged
methods.description: Updates the view's appearance based on selection state.
